stage0.criteria: G1 source identity/authority; G2 claim truth and limits; G3 element ownership/relations; G4 CQ/SAP positive-negative-UNKNOWN; G5 Root/AOT-runtime/platform boundaries

findings.detail: The sole HAS_SEMANTIC_CHILD relation was a hierarchy edge and represented only Root->Goal while the hierarchy contained 16 ownership edges. Separated all 16 hierarchy edges from the semantic relation graph and replaced the misclassified relation with a source-grounded FileAsset->GlobalAuthority relation.
All 13 invariants now have explicit appliesTo and cqRefs; each of 17 Elements carries globalInvariantRefs, cqRefs and relationRefs; Root carries all invariant obligations.

All 17 SAP profiles now have stable per-obligation IDs, source/relation/invariant/CQ refs, positive/negative/UNKNOWN cases, oracle classes and NOT_RUN/NOT_QUALIFIED states. Added missing FileAsset CQ-019. No SAP PASS is claimed.
Updated K1 from stale 33 locator count to 70 internal records, 13 external locators and 65 exact Code/Test blobs.
Added current Microsoft Windows client servicing locator, exact release/build lifecycle observations and CQ-020. WinGet/API compatibility is explicitly distinct from OS servicing and Shun support.

Claim and Relation status fields used author-specific labels rather than the DKE canonical SUPPORTED/CONDITIONAL/UNKNOWN taxonomy. Canonical status is now explicit; original author labels are retained as authorStatus.

Element responsibility/boundary existed, but purpose, non-goals, applicability, cross-references and oracle were not consolidated as a first-class Scope contract. Added scopeContract to all 17 Elements and mirrored it in the coverage map.

ownerClosureCorrection.note: The owning Global Semantic Element is now included in its own globalInvariantRefs, in addition to every explicitly applicable Element. SAP profile and obligation source/invariant refs were recomputed from the final closure map.
